title: Juniper and the Parish
author: W. M. Fairweather
blurb: Rafael Nakamura, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
